escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection — RCE risk if templates ever receive user input
escalations.action_required: Code review: confirm no user-controlled data reaches Handlebars template compilation. Patch to >=4.7.9 immediately regardless.

escalations.title: form-data CRLF Injection — HTTP header injection / request smuggling risk
escalations.action_required: Code review: verify all file upload paths; ensure attacker-controlled filenames/field names are never forwarded as multipart form headers to upstream services.

escalations.title: React Router Open Redirect — phishing risk via protocol-relative path navigation
escalations.action_required: Code review: audit all useNavigate() and <Navigate> usages to ensure no untrusted user input flows into the 'to' prop/argument. Patch to >=6.30.4 immediately.

backlog.title: Handlebars.js Multiple Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
backlog.exploit_scenario: If any user input reaches Handlebars template compilation (direct or via library), attacker achieves arbitrary JavaScript execution (RCE). Prototype pollution can lead to XSS even with static templates.
backlog.impact: Critical — full code execution or XSS across Backend, Frontend, portal/Backend
backlog.fix: npm install handlebars@latest --save; npm audit fix

backlog.title: form-data CRLF Injection — HTTP Header Injection (CVSS 7.5)
backlog.exploit_scenario: Attacker provides a filename or field name containing CRLF sequences. If the app forwards multipart forms to upstream services, attacker can inject arbitrary HTTP headers, enabling request smuggling or response splitting.
backlog.impact: High — HTTP header injection, potential request smuggling
backlog.fix: npm install form-data@4.0.6 --save

backlog.title: WebSocket (ws) Regular Expression Denial of Service
backlog.exploit_scenario: If app uses WebSocket connections and an attacker can control incoming frame headers, crafted input triggers pathological regex performance, causing CPU exhaustion and service unavailability.
backlog.impact: High — CPU exhaustion / service DoS on WebSocket connections
backlog.fix: npm install ws@>=8.17.1 --save (or upgrade vite which pulls this transitively)

backlog.title: Vite Development Server Multiple Vulnerabilities (dev-env CORS/SOP bypass)
backlog.exploit_scenario: During local development, a malicious website can make cross-origin requests to the Vite dev server (localhost:5173) and read responses, exfiltrating local source code and data.
backlog.impact: High — developer credential / source code exfiltration during local development
backlog.fix: npm install vite@latest --save-dev

backlog.title: Traceability Enforcer Only Covers 1 of 8 Active Plans; portal/ Not Scanned
backlog.exploit_scenario: 7 of 8 plans (dependency-linking, image-upload, dev-cycle-traceability, etc.) are never automatically verified for spec-coverage. Spec drift accumulates silently over time.
backlog.impact: Medium — systemic blind spot in CI; new spec gaps will not be caught
backlog.fix: Add --file invocations for each active plan in CI; extend source-dir scanning to portal/

backlog.title: FR-dependency-* Traceability IDs Misnamed — 13 of 16 Spec IDs Untraceable
backlog.exploit_scenario: Automated checks for FR-dependency-search, FR-dependency-schema, FR-dependency-metrics etc. return zero hits even though code is implemented. Future drift goes undetected.
backlog.impact: Medium — traceability automation produces false negatives
backlog.fix: Global replace in portal/ to align // Verifies: comments with exact IDs from Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md

backlog.title: FR-dependency-api-types STILL OPEN — blocked_by Missing From API Update Types
backlog.exploit_scenario: TypeScript compiler cannot catch invalid shapes passed to dependency update APIs. If API contract changes, the as-any casts in DependencyPicker.tsx silently hide breakage until runtime.
backlog.impact: Medium — type safety bypass; hidden API contract drift
backlog.fix: Add blocked_by?: string[] to UpdateFeatureRequestInput and UpdateBugInput in portal/Shared/api.ts; remove as any casts from DependencyPicker.tsx

backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed STILL OPEN — portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts Absent
backlog.exploit_scenario: Portal boots with no dependency relationships seeded. The DependencySection and BlockedBadge UI render empty state, making the dependency feature invisible during spot-testing and demos.
backlog.impact: Medium — feature unverifiable in default development state
backlog.fix: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with idempotent inserts per FR-dependency-seed spec; wire into server startup

backlog.title: teamDispatches.ts — Direct SQL in Route Handler (CLAUDE.md Architecture Violation)
backlog.exploit_scenario: If SQL queries need to change (e.g., add filtering, pagination), developers must edit route handlers directly, bypassing service-layer pattern. Increases risk of inconsistency and untestable business logic.
backlog.impact: Medium — architectural debt; route logic cannot be unit-tested independently
backlog.fix: Create portal/Backend/src/services/teamDispatchService.ts; move SQL there; update route to call service

backlog.title: UUID Buffer Overflow (CVSS 7.5) — Source/Backend uuid@9.0.0
backlog.exploit_scenario: If uuid.v3(), v5(), or v6() is called with a caller-provided output buffer that is too small, out-of-bounds write occurs. Exploitable if application passes untrusted buffer sizes.
backlog.impact: Moderate — potential out-of-bounds write in UUID generation hot path
backlog.fix: npm install uuid@9.0.1 --save (patch) or uuid@14.0.1 (major upgrade)

backlog.title: Express / qs DoS — TypeError on null Entries in Query Strings (CVSS 5.3)
backlog.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends query string with comma-formatted arrays containing null/undefined entries when encodeValuesOnly is set. qs.stringify crashes with TypeError, causing 500 and temporary service unavailability.
backlog.impact: Moderate — DoS via crafted query string
backlog.fix: npm install express@4.22.2 --save

backlog.title: brace-expansion ReDoS — Process Hang on Zero-Step Sequences (CVSS 6.5)
backlog.exploit_scenario: If glob patterns from test configs or build tools can be controlled by user input, a pattern like {z..a} causes quadratic backtracking that hangs the process indefinitely consuming memory.
backlog.impact: Moderate — process hang / OOM in build or test pipeline
backlog.fix: npm install brace-expansion@>=1.1.13 --save-dev

backlog.title: js-yaml Quadratic-Complexity DoS on Nested Aliases (CVSS 5.3)
backlog.exploit_scenario: Malformed YAML config with deeply nested merge key aliases causes O(n²) parsing time. If config files or test data originate from untrusted sources, this hangs the process.
backlog.impact: Moderate — DoS if YAML input comes from untrusted source
backlog.fix: npm install js-yaml@latest --save

backlog.title: esbuild Dev Server CORS/SOP Bypass (CVSS 5.3) — Dev Environment
backlog.exploit_scenario: During development, a malicious website visited by a developer can make cross-origin requests to esbuild's dev server on localhost and read responses, exfiltrating local source code.
backlog.impact: Moderate — developer code exfiltration during local dev (not exploitable in production)
backlog.fix: npm install vite@latest --save-dev (includes patched esbuild)

backlog.title: React Router Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URL Paths
backlog.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts a link on the app with path starting // (e.g., //${attacker.com}/evil). React Router treats it as a protocol-relative URL and navigates to the external site, enabling phishing.
backlog.impact: High — phishing / credential theft via open redirect
backlog.fix: npm install react-router-dom@6.30.4 --save

backlog.title: uuid Major Version Behind + CVE (Buffer Overflow)
backlog.exploit_scenario: Same as DEP-004. Current 9.0.0 contains unpatched buffer overflow CVE. Latest 14.x adds v6/v7 algorithms.
backlog.impact: Moderate — same CVE impact as DEP-004
backlog.fix: npm install uuid@14.0.1 --save

backlog.title: react-router-dom Major Version Behind + Open Redirect CVE
backlog.exploit_scenario: Same as DEP-010. Current 6.26.0 contains unpatched open redirect CVE; v7 available.
backlog.impact: High — same open redirect impact as DEP-010
backlog.fix: npm install react-router-dom@6.30.4 --save (minimum) or 7.18.1 (major upgrade)

backlog.title: FR-dependency-frontend-tests STILL OPEN — DependencySection & BlockedBadge Tests Missing
backlog.exploit_scenario: DependencySection (226 lines) and BlockedBadge (70 lines) have no tests. Regressions in dependency UI go undetected until manual QA.
backlog.impact: Low — regression risk for dependency feature UI
backlog.fix: Create portal/Frontend/tests/DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx with Verifies: comments

backlog.title: FR-TMP-008 Implemented in Dockerfile.worker But Not Traced
backlog.exploit_scenario: If FR-TMP-008 requirements are checked by automated tooling, the Playwright install lines in Dockerfile.worker return zero traceability hits, potentially flagging a false spec-gap.
backlog.impact: Low — traceability tooling false negative for FR-TMP-008
backlog.fix: Add # Verifies: FR-TMP-008 comment above Playwright install lines in Dockerfile.worker

backlog.title: 15 Portal Frontend Components Lack Any Test Coverage
backlog.exploit_scenario: SummaryWidgets, ActivityFeed, ApprovalQueue, PhaseStepper, TicketBoard, RepoSelector, VoteResults, FeatureRequestList, RunDetailRow, RunsTab, LearningsList, BugList, TeamsPage have no tests. UI regressions are invisible to CI.
backlog.impact: Low-Medium — broad regression blindspot in portal UI
backlog.fix: Prioritize PhaseStepper, TicketBoard (FR-027, FR-045, FR-064), then RepoSelector, TeamsPage

backlog.title: PostCSS XSS via Unescaped </style> in CSS Stringify (CVSS 6.1)
backlog.exploit_scenario: If CSS is dynamically generated or user-controlled, PostCSS may emit unescaped </style> tags, breaking CSS context in HTML and enabling XSS.
backlog.impact: Low (static CSS only) — escalates to High if user-controlled CSS is ever introduced
backlog.fix: npm install postcss@latest --save-dev

backlog.title: express 1 Minor Version Behind (4.18.2 → 4.22.2)
backlog.exploit_scenario: Security patches in 4.19-4.22 range not applied. DEP-005 (qs DoS) is fixed in 4.22.2.
backlog.impact: Low — missing minor-version security patches; overlaps with DEP-005
backlog.fix: npm install express@4.22.2 --save

backlog.title: pino Logging Library Behind Minor Version (8.17.0 → 8.21.0)
backlog.exploit_scenario: May be missing logging security enhancements. No CVEs currently identified.
backlog.impact: Low — minor version drift; no current CVEs
backlog.fix: npm install pino@8.21.0 --save

backlog.title: React 1 Major Version Behind (18.3.1 → 19.2.7)
backlog.exploit_scenario: No current CVEs in React 18.3.1. Missing React 19 performance improvements and new features.
backlog.impact: Low — optional upgrade; React 18.x is stable LTS
backlog.fix: npm install react@19.2.7 react-dom@19.2.7 --save (evaluate breaking changes first)

backlog.title: eslint-disable in 2 Production Source Files (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps)
backlog.exploit_scenario: Suppressed linting rules may hide stale closures or missing effect dependencies. If deps change, silently incorrect behavior may result.
backlog.impact: Low — pattern violation; potential for subtle effect bugs
backlog.fix: Audit each suppression; add safe: comment if intentional, or fix dep array

backlog.title: @babel/core Arbitrary File Read via Malicious sourceMappingURL (CVSS 3.2)
backlog.exploit_scenario: If Babel compiles untrusted JavaScript with a crafted sourceMappingURL comment pointing to a local file, that file could be included in source maps. Low risk in typical locked-down build pipelines.
backlog.impact: Very Low — exploitable only if Babel processes untrusted JS input
backlog.fix: Upgrade Babel to latest (check for breaking changes first)
